evidence.title: FDA (2018), Liposome Drug Products guidance
evidence.text: The guidance discusses liposome product characterization and separates chemistry, manufacturing and controls from pharmacokinetics and bioavailability evidence.
evidence.limitation: General guidance. It does not establish delivery to a target tissue for an untested formulation.

evidence.title: Eugster et al. (2024), Leveraging machine learning to streamline the development of liposomal drug delivery systems
evidence.text: The study related liposome formation and size to chip geometry, lipid composition and microfluidic flow settings. Its size regression used a screened subset of runs.
evidence.limitation: This is the training source for the Eugster model. It cannot independently confirm that model or establish drug-specific loading, release or tissue delivery.

evidence.title: USP-NF General Chapter <1154> Liposome Drug Products
evidence.text: Liposomes have a lipid bilayer and an aqueous compartment. The aqueous compartment and lipid bilayer provide distinct locations for incorporating water-soluble and lipophilic payloads. Product-specific characterization depends on the formulation and route.
evidence.limitation: General formulation guidance. Provides neither a drug-specific ratio nor a performance prediction.
